thought.text: The game's Babylon.js code doesn't use the software fallback options. Let me inject a fix:

reasoning_content:
The WebGL test worked but the actual game still shows black. The issue is that I added the WebGL context check before loading the main.js - but the game code itself (main-CLZYnZ3S.js) might not be using the same context options.

Let me check what's in the main.js - maybe Babylon needs to be configured to use software rendering. The client code itself needs to request WebGL with the failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat option.

Actually - wait - I added a script to try to get WebGL context BEFORE the main.js loads. But the game's main code ALSO tries to get WebGL - and it doesn't use those options. That's where it's failing!

I need to modify the actual client code (main.js) to use those WebGL options. But that's in the build bundle - can't easily modify it.

Alternative - I can inject the WebGL fix BEFORE main.js runs, by adding code that overrides how canvas.getContext works! Let me try that.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Override canvas.getContext to always use software fallback
fix = b'''<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000" />
<title>Arelorian</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/MMORPGClientCore-Bf6Bj3Nv.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/main-hKkHMhy1.css">
<script>
// FORCE software WebGL for all canvas elements
(function(){
var origGetContext=HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext;
HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext=function(type,opts){
  if(type==='webgl'||type==='experimental-webgl'||type==='webgl2'){
    opts=Object.assign({},opts,{failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat:false});
  }
  return origGetContext.call(this,type,opts);
};
})();
</script>
<script src="/assets/vendor-BVz5TCBb.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/MMORPGClientCore-DLUgQ5Dc.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/services-C3ENgesv.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/rolldown-runtime-DwmM5USC.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/main-CLZYnZ3S.js"></script>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#000}
#application-canvas{width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="application-canvas"></canvas>
</body>
</html>'''

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/game.html', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(fix)

c.exec_command('cp /tmp/game.html /opt/areloria/client/dist/index.html')
print('WebGL fix injected!')

c.close()
EOF
